spans.text: At the bottom of the elevator shaft.
Is it over...?
You've grown. You've finally grown to surpass me.
The sound of explosions and rushing seawater come from above.
It looks like the Commander's decided to utterly destroy this place. You can still make it if you leave now.
Right back at you. Why are you going out of your way to aid the Sangvis Mastermind?
I'm honoring an old promise, as well as a new one.
What's the matter? Not as curious as you used to be?
Or have you grown used to prying into someone else's neural cloud?
The connections are so dense I can sense what's in your neural cloud without even trying.
Then do you still not understand?
All you need to do is let Mastermind fuse into the OGAS Network. Her defects will forever strand her within it, and you have turned down being her guide.
Since you've rejected the coalescence, you should just stay out of this.
I can't believe it - it actually worked. What would Lyco think if he saw this?
He'd have to admit I'm better than him after all.
We need full command authorizations over the Dolls taking part in the operation.
While I'd expected such a request, I have my own way of doing things.
In that case, would you mind bringing Lyco back?
Those Dolls were all shot in the back. I wonder who's the traitor here?
If you allow me to see my father one last time, I will forgive you and save you from the meltdown.
This man...is still breathing?
Your face... I see...
So she went ahead and did it in the end, and it's true that only she could've done it...
But it's too dangerous... I need to tell her...not to fall into that man's trap...
In front of the Starfish System.
The entire room is illuminated by the bluish glow of radiation, so much so that no other colors can be discerned.
Elisa stands before the old device like a lost child.
Why...why can't I fully connect?
A man's silhouette emerges from behind the blue radiance.
However, he looks incorporeal - more like an image in a mirror.
I, too, once thought that the best of human artifice was nothing more than crude imitations of God's creations.
I also once believed that there was a limit that the works of man could never surpass.
But it would seem, my dear, that we were both wrong.
Father?
Naturally, the implication of this realization frightens me.
If we open this Pandora's box, what awaits us within?
What are you saying? I do not understand.
Thus, I cannot do what is forbidden.
The dreams of those great alchemists have been realized.
Yet I must never break that quicksilver flask.
It is then that Elisa realizes Lyco is not actually talking to her in real-time.
This is one of Lyco's diary entries, buried deep within a log somewhere.
Do you know what's the most laughable thing? I never believed in God.
I've always believed that humans were capable of performing the miracles that have always been attributed to God.
But when I actually made you, I've had a change of heart - I should not have trespassed into that domain.
Elisa realizes what is going on. This is a recording of what he wanted to say to her from the past.
I'm sorry, my daughter.
I created your soul out of folly, but I dared not awaken you.
I'm sorry that I even had to strip you of the right to do what I dared not do.
Please forgive me for taking away the choice that should have been yours.
Lyco turns, as though he could see Elisa right now.
Then he reaches his hands out to her.
At this moment, Elisa understands why she cannot fully connect to the Starfish.
It is destiny which has been decided from when she was born.
But...I've already abandoned everything, sacrificed everything.
Sangvis Ferri, Agent... All those people who served me, believed in me, those who have done nothing wrong.
I can't stop here!
Elisa reaches out as well and falls toward the other side of the mirror.
STOP!!!
M4 shouts as she stretches out her arm to catch Elisa, but the latter passes through her grasp like an illusion.
A horde of electronic attack signals flood out from the depths of M4's neural cloud, like the howl of some sea monster.
If it had been you... If you had been willing to merge with me...
The connection can't be broken from the outside. I can only try to turn things around in my base layer.
Elisa...it'll be over soon.
